Follow image link: (https://nexo.com/en-us/earn-crypto?utm_source=theblock&utm_campaign=theblock_newsletter_savings)
Caption: 

———————————————————————————

----------
Happy Monday! [Bitcoin](https://www.theblock.co/price/bitcoin) remains below $77,000 amid outflows from spot bitcoin ETFs following the record Binance hack.

In today's newsletter, Strategy buys another 811 bitcoin for $65.5 million, Brazil's largest crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin suffers a $46 million security breach, spot bitcoin ETFs see their largest daily outflows in four months, and more.

Meanwhile, Binance [sees](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-01-binance-sees-3-64-billion-in-net-outflows-after-reopening-withdrawals-following-record-hack-432259) $3.64 billion in net outflows after reopening withdrawals, and Strive [inches](https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-02-strive-inches-closer-second-largest-public-bitcoin-holder-10-million-buy-432312) closer to becoming the second-largest public bitcoin holder after its latest $10 million buy.

P.S. Don't forget to check out [The Latent](https://thelatent.co/), our sister website covering AI. Get The Latent Daily [here](https://thelatent.co/newsletter) and all other The Block newsletters [here](https://www.theblock.co/newsletters). Also, follow [The Block](https://x.com/TheBlockCo) and [The Latent](https://x.com/TheLatentCo) on X for more updates.


----------———————————————————————————

----------
# THE BIG ONE

## ₿ Strategy buys another 811 bitcoin for $65.5 million, taking holdings to 849,327 BTC


----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/23b4eb09-f47b-49d9-a74e-2bbbc95be649/Screenshot-2026-11-02-at-11.29.14-1200x673.png?t=1793656491) [Strategy]
Follow image link: (https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-11-02-we-found-room-for-even-more-orange-michael-saylor-strategy-bitcoin-btc-432275)
Caption: 

----------
Michael Saylor's Strategy purchased another 811 bitcoin for around $65.5 million between Oct. 26 and Nov. 1, resuming acquisitions after a one-week pause.

* Strategy paid an average of $80,846 per bitcoin, bringing its total holdings to 849,327 BTC, acquired for about $64.1 billion at an average price of $75,451 per coin.

* The latest purchase was funded through sales of MSTR common stock. Strategy sold around $164 milli
